entities.summary: Svetlana Dmitriyevna Yudina, better known by her stage name Lana (Лана), is a Russian singer based in South Korea. In June 2019, she debuted as the first Russian K-pop idol with the single "Take The Wheel". Lana was a architects & designers from Poronaysk (b. 1996-11-23, Poronaysk). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
